```{r}
# Working directory
setwd("/Users/nico/work/khat_gwas/fusion")

# Base directory containing ku/ and kuf/
base_dir <- "/Users/nico/work/khat_gwas/fusion"

# Recursively find ALL .dat files
fusion_files <- list.files(
  path = base_dir,
  pattern = "\\.dat$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Number of files found
length(fusion_files)

# Print all file paths
fusion_files


```

```{r}
# Calculate the local Bonferroni threshold for every FUSION file
file_bonf <- lapply(fusion_files, function(f) {

  df <- fread(f)

  # Valid TWAS tests
  n_tests <- sum(
    !is.na(as.numeric(df$TWAS.P)) &
    as.numeric(df$TWAS.P) > 0
  )

  # Local Bonferroni threshold
  bonf_p <- 0.05 / n_tests

  # Extract tissue name
  tissue <- basename(f)
  tissue <- gsub("^.*GTExv8\\.ALL\\.", "", tissue)
  tissue <- gsub("\\.all_chr\\.dat$", "", tissue)

  # Determine phenotype
  phenotype <- ifelse(
    grepl("/kuf/", f),
    "KUF",
    ifelse(grepl("/ku/", f), "KU", NA)
  )

  data.frame(
    file = f,
    phenotype = phenotype,
    tissue = tissue,
    n_tests = n_tests,
    bonf_p = bonf_p
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Display local Bonferroni thresholds
file_bonf
```

```{r}
write.csv(
  file_bonf,
  file = "local_bonferroni_thresholds.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# GTEx v8 uses GENCODE v26 on GRCh38
gencode_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "gencode.v26.annotation.gtf.gz"
)

# Download GENCODE v26 if it is not already present
if (!file.exists(gencode_file)) {
  download.file(
    url = paste0(
      "https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/",
      "Gencode_human/release_26/gencode.v26.annotation.gtf.gz"
    ),
    destfile = gencode_file,
    mode = "wb"
  )
}

# Read the GENCODE annotation
gencode_v26 <- rtracklayer::import(gencode_file)

# Create Ensembl ID-to-gene-symbol lookup table
gene_lookup <- as.data.frame(gencode_v26) %>%
  dplyr::filter(type == "gene") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    ENSEMBL = sub("\\..*$", "", as.character(gene_id)),
    gene_symbol = as.character(gene_name)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(ENSEMBL),
    !is.na(gene_symbol),
    gene_symbol != ""
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(ENSEMBL, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# KU FUSION Manhattan plots

ku_files <- fusion_files[grepl("/ku/", fusion_files)]

for (f in ku_files) {

  df <- fread(f)

plot_df <- df %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    fusion_ID = as.character(ID),

    # Remove the Ensembl version suffix, such as ".3"
    ENSEMBL = sub("\\..*$", "", as.character(ID)),

    CHR = as.integer(CHR),
    BP = (as.numeric(P0) + as.numeric(P1)) / 2,
    P = as.numeric(TWAS.P)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(ENSEMBL),
    !is.na(CHR),
    !is.na(BP),
    !is.na(P),
    P > 0
  )

plot_df <- df %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    fusion_ID = as.character(ID),
    ENSEMBL = sub("\\..*$", "", as.character(ID)),
    CHR = as.integer(CHR),
    BP = (as.numeric(P0) + as.numeric(P1)) / 2,
    P = as.numeric(TWAS.P)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(ENSEMBL),
    !is.na(CHR),
    !is.na(BP),
    !is.na(P),
    P > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_lookup,
    by = "ENSEMBL"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # qqman uses SNP as the annotation label
    SNP = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(gene_symbol) & gene_symbol != "",
      gene_symbol,
      fusion_ID
    )
  )
  tissue <- basename(f)
  tissue <- gsub("^.*GTExv8\\.ALL\\.", "", tissue)
  tissue <- gsub("\\.all_chr\\.dat$", "", tissue)

  local_bonf <- file_bonf %>%
    dplyr::filter(file == f) %>%
    dplyr::pull(bonf_p)

  plot_title <- paste0(
    "Khat Use x ",
    tissue,
    " | Bonf. P = ",
    signif(local_bonf, 3)
  )

  manhattan(
    plot_df,
    main = plot_title,
    cex.main = 1,
    suggestiveline = FALSE,
    genomewideline = FALSE,

    # Annotate every gene passing the local threshold
    annotatePval = local_bonf,
    annotateTop = FALSE
  )

  abline(
    h = -log10(local_bonf),
    col = "red",
    lty = 2,
    lwd = 1.5
  )
}

```

```{r}

read_fusion_set <- function(files, phenotype_label) {

  data.table::rbindlist(
    lapply(files, function(f) {

      df <- data.table::fread(f)

      # Extract tissue
      tissue <- basename(f)
      tissue <- gsub("^.*GTExv8\\.ALL\\.", "", tissue)
      tissue <- gsub("\\.all_chr\\.dat$", "", tissue)

      # Get local Bonferroni information
      bonf_info <- file_bonf %>%
        dplyr::filter(file == f)

      local_bonf <- bonf_info$bonf_p
      n_tests <- bonf_info$n_tests

      df %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          phenotype = phenotype_label,
          tissue = tissue,

          # File information
          file = f,
          n_tests = n_tests,
          local_bonf = local_bonf,

          # Convert values to numeric
          TWAS.P = as.numeric(TWAS.P),
          TWAS.Z = as.numeric(TWAS.Z),

          COLOC.PP0 = as.numeric(COLOC.PP0),
          COLOC.PP1 = as.numeric(COLOC.PP1),
          COLOC.PP2 = as.numeric(COLOC.PP2),
          COLOC.PP3 = as.numeric(COLOC.PP3),
          COLOC.PP4 = as.numeric(COLOC.PP4),

          # logP
          logP = -log10(TWAS.P)
        )
    }),
    fill = TRUE
  )
}
```

```{r}

# Create KU and KUF coloc files
ku_files <- fusion_files[grepl("/ku/", fusion_files)]
kuf_files <- fusion_files[grepl("/kuf/", fusion_files)]

ku_all <- read_fusion_set(
  ku_files,
  "KU"
)

kuf_all <- read_fusion_set(
  kuf_files,
  "KUF"
)
```

```{r}

# remove invalid twas p-values
ku_noNA <- ku_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(TWAS.P),
    TWAS.P > 0,
    !is.na(logP)
  )

kuf_noNA <- kuf_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(TWAS.P),
    TWAS.P > 0,
    !is.na(logP)
  )
```

```{r}
# get the global bonferroni threshold for both KU and KUF
ku_global_bonf <- 0.05 / nrow(ku_noNA)
kuf_global_bonf <- 0.05 / nrow(kuf_noNA)


```

```{r}
# Prepare KU volcano data with gene symbols and labels
ku_volcano <- ku_noNA %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ENSEMBL = sub("\\..*$", "", as.character(ID))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_lookup,
    by = "ENSEMBL"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Fall back to the original Ensembl ID if no symbol is available
    plot_gene = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(gene_symbol) & gene_symbol != "",
      gene_symbol,
      as.character(ID)
    ),

    # Example: Testis:chr1:NOC2L
    plot_label = paste0(
      tissue,
      ":chr",
      CHR,
      ":",
      plot_gene
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# KU coloc volcano plot
ggplot(
  ku_volcano,
  aes(
    x = TWAS.Z,
    y = logP,
    color = COLOC.PP4
  )
) +

  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 1
  ) +

  # Global Bonferroni threshold
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(ku_global_bonf),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  # Annotate only globally significant genes
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = ku_volcano %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        TWAS.P < ku_global_bonf
      ),
    aes(label = plot_label),
    color = "black",
    size = 3,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    segment.color = "gray50",
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_color_viridis_c(
    na.value = "gray75",
    option = "viridis"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  labs(
    title = "Khat Use: Volcano Plot for All TWAS Results",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Global Bonferroni P = ",
      signif(ku_global_bonf, 3),
      " | N = ",
      nrow(ku_noNA),
      " tests"
    ),
    x = "TWAS Z-score",
    y = expression(-log[10](TWAS.P)),
    color = "COLOC PP4"
  )
```

```{r}
# KUF coloc density plots
kuf_pp_long <- kuf_all %>%
  dplyr::select(
    phenotype,
    tissue,
    ID,
    COLOC.PP0,
    COLOC.PP1,
    COLOC.PP2,
    COLOC.PP3,
    COLOC.PP4
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("COLOC.PP"),
    names_to = "PP_type",
    values_to = "PP"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(PP))

ggplot(
  kuf_pp_long,
  aes(x = PP)
) +

  geom_density(
    fill = "darkorange",
    alpha = 0.5,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ PP_type,
    nrow = 1,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "KUF: COLOC Posterior Probability Densities",
    x = "Posterior Probability",
    y = "Density"
  )
```

    x = logP,
    y = COLOC.PP2
  )
) +

  geom_point(
    aes(color = COLOC.PP2),
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 1.5
  ) +

  # Global Bonferroni threshold
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = -log10(ku_global_bonf),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  # Colocalization threshold
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.8,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "darkgreen",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  # Annotate only globally Bonferroni-significant genes
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = kuf_volcano %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(COLOC.PP2),
        TWAS.P < ku_global_bonf
      ),
    aes(label = plot_label),
    color = "black",
    size = 3,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    segment.color = "gray50",
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  labs(
    title = "Khat Use: TWAS Significance vs COLOC.PP2",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Global Bonferroni P = ",
      signif(ku_global_bonf, 3)
    ),
    x = expression(-log[10](TWAS.P)),
    y = "COLOC.PP2",
    color = "PP2"
  )
